component.name: Calculator
component.summary: Calculate, convert units and currencies, and work in binary

description.p: Calculator is the Bingux desktop's calculator. Type an expression or press the keys, and the result shows as you type.

ul.li: Exact arithmetic: 0.1 + 0.2 is 0.3, and 100! shows every digit
Basic, Scientific, Programmer and Convert modes
Percent that works as it does on a till, and a history that is kept
Binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal side by side, with a grid of bits
Length, mass, temperature, data, currency and more, with offline exchange rates
